senses.meaning: Ngã tư, giao lộ (chỗ hai hoặc nhiều đường giao nhau)
examples: The accident happened at the intersection of Main Street and Oak Avenue.
Turn left at the next intersection.
A traffic light was installed at the busy intersection.
We found our reserved seats in carriage six.
The train has eight carriages.
First-class carriages are at the front of the train.
Cinderella arrived at the ball in a golden carriage.
Horse-drawn carriages were common before automobiles.
The royal carriage was polished to a shine.

note: Hai nghĩa chính: (1) toa xe lửa; (2) xe ngựa kéo.

senses.meaning: Chỗ giao nhau của đường bộ hoặc đường sắt; nút giao thông
examples: Take the motorway exit at junction 14.
The two railway lines meet at this junction.
The town grew up at the junction of two rivers.

senses.meaning: Cầu vượt (đường bộ đi trên đường hoặc đường sắt bên dưới)
examples: The new overpass was built to reduce traffic congestion.
Pedestrians use the overpass to cross the busy highway.
Construction of the overpass will take six months.

note: Tiếng Anh Mỹ dùng 'overpass'; tiếng Anh Anh thường dùng 'flyover'.

senses.meaning: Đoàn xe/tàu hộ tống; đoàn phương tiện di chuyển cùng nhau
examples: A military convoy moved through the city at dawn.
Aid workers traveled in a convoy for safety.
The president's convoy consisted of ten armored vehicles.

senses.meaning: Đường giao thông huyết mạch, tuyến đường chính
examples: The highway is the main artery connecting the two cities.
Traffic on the city's main arteries came to a standstill.
This road serves as a vital artery for regional trade.

note: 'Artery' còn nghĩa là 'động mạch' trong y học — xem file Y học & Sinh học.
